messages.subject: Re: Unable to run wallace
parts:
Thank you for sharing this information!

Your problem is with the 'httpuv' package, which is a dependency on the shiny package (an important package to load the graphic interface). Please, try to install them again with:

install.packages("httpuv")
install.packages("shiny")

If you got this pop-up question: "Do you want to install from sources the packages which need compilation?" Select NO.

If there is no problem installing these packages, Wallace should work.

Please, let us know if this fixes your problem.

Best,
Gonzalo

messages.author: ca8e09d7b1424531
messages.subject: Re: Unable to run wallace
parts:
HI, 

thanks for your responses. I managed to resolve the problem yesterday. All I needed to do was to install the package "devtools" and follow the instructions that 
were laid out on the wallace github (https://cmerow.github.io/RDataScience/3_4_wallace.html)

for those of you with a similar problem perhaps this might help as well, follow these steps:

# if you do not have devtools installed, install it first

install.packages("devtools", repos = "http://cran.us.r-project.org")

 # install wallace from github

 devtools::install_github("wallaceEcoMod/wallace")

#at this point you will be asked whether you want to update all the packages with their recent versions. Type  the number "1" into R to update all the packages) 
#once that is done, load wallace.

install.packages(c("wallace", "ENMeval"))

# run the user interface

library("wallace")
run_wallace()
